review.mode: read-only complete diff/callers, no delegation or independent human review claimed
review.finding: Three P2 findings across implementation and follow-up reviews: nullable legacy goal text could throw; generic invoice reduction/payment outcomes could borrow a collections contribution; clear/reduce variants still admitted explicit supplier payables after the initial invoice correction.
review.resolution: String guards make nullable historical text abstain. Qualified collection outcomes exclude generic billing/settlement. An invoice-specific payable-context veto now checks title, description and success criteria across the full current path before ranking. Eight new labeled cases and a persisted-read regression cover the remaining finding, including a payable criterion competing with customer receivables; red results are preserved.

manual_checks.check: Deployed runtime, native UI, independent human/blinded field or paid model evaluation
manual_checks.reason: Bounded service card tested with isolated synthetic fixtures; no real provider effects or paid evaluation required.

limitations: Bounded English outcome vocabulary and lexical exclusions can miss useful paraphrases or fail to identify unmarked non-operational text. Development labels are author-visible; there is no independent human/field accuracy result. Mixed payable/receivable context conservatively abstains for collection proposals; explicit user confirmation remains available.
90-day updated_at freshness is a conservative heuristic, not proof of user review. Long-lived useful goals, oversized criteria and nullable legacy data can abstain.
At the 1000-goal reader cap inferred relevance abstains, even for exactly 1000 goals.
Declared objective paths and routine evidence cannot verify account/customer ownership, causal business impact, completed work or workflow feasibility. Candidates always require confirmation.
Stored suggestion context remains a timestamped discovery snapshot; current inferred-relation consumers must use getOpportunity/listOpportunities. Existing composition ignores inferred candidates.
rollback: Disable awareness for containment. Restore the prior versioned relevance seam while retaining Q-11 privacy/recurrence and current stale-goal filtering, or return no inferred goal candidates. Keep additive data, historical hypotheses, explicit confirmations and user work; never replay effects or alter scores.
